q: Why is expand/shrink O(n) despite the inner while loop?
options: The while loop runs at most once
left and right each move at most n times in total
why: Count pointer moves across the whole run, not per iteration: 2n moves at most.

q: For the SHORTEST valid window, when do you record the answer?
options: While the window is valid, before each shrink
why: Every valid window is a candidate; shrinking tries to make it shorter while it stays valid.

q: "Longest subarray with sum ≤ k" and the array contains negative numbers. Is a sliding window safe?
options: No: shrinking may increase the sum, so the window can't tell which way to move
why: Sliding windows need adding to only increase the metric and removing to only decrease it.

q: With last-seen jumping, what is the answer for s = "abba"?
why: At the final 'a' its last index is 0, but l is already 2, so max(l, 1) keeps l = 2. Window "ba", length 2.

q: How do you count subarrays with EXACTLY k distinct values using windows?
why: At-most-k is a clean shrink-when-invalid window. Exactly k is the difference of two at-most counts.

q: Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock as a window: when does the left edge (buy day) move?
options: When a new lowest price appears
why: Selling later always pairs best with the cheapest earlier day, so the left edge jumps to each new minimum.
